notes.title: To all Commanders: Development Update on The Book of Yog
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Starting this week, Hangzhou has slipped into late summer—sometimes a little cool breeze, and autumn is quietly sneaking in. About two months ago we shared our dev log with you, but since the upcoming content is huge, the game's development has recently slowed down. So here's a little progress update from us:


1. Endgame PvE (Otherworld)
• New loot will be added gradually, including legendary gear, treasures, and upgrade stones.

• Equipment will have more randomness. Special gear has unique attributes that cannot be modified. No paid content—everything depends on luck. Trading Hall support is planned.

• PvE tests farming strategies, map and loot knowledge, and team planning for optimal Magic Find routes.

•Not mindless grinding: maps have unique strategies, drops, rare bosses, and special modes.

•Seasonal model will bring new maps, mechanics, and loot each season.

•Release: aiming for late October, latest by late November.


2. New Social & PvP 
We're also working on a big tech upgrade to roll out a new open-world scene.

Here, players in the same region will finally be connected live—you'll see each other moving around, interacting, and fighting for resources and cities, or just roaming the world for fun.

It's basically going to be a massive seafaring world, where you can build your own fleet and sail out to conquer the seas. Development is moving fast, and we'll share more soon!


3. Combat Balance
We are working on combat balance. Given the complexity of online play and the need to protect players' interests, we are still in the research and calculation stage. Our goals are:

• SP heroes should be relatively balanced, with no completely unusable characters.

• Improve and unify game mechanics, reduce redundant designs, and create multiple viable playstyles with dynamic balance, rather than crude rock-paper-scissors or dominance by a single option.

• Differences between hero tiers should be reasonable, aiming for a more balanced system that enhances the depth and seriousness of combat.


4. Looking Forward
Running this game has taught us a lot, and your feedback has been huge. Our promise: better balance, smoother progression and collection, and more fun social systems.

Thanks so much for playing Book of Yog. Your support keeps us going—see you in the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/fccec7abbd7815edffcffb06e43b9942490328d4.png

【Paid Adjustment】
After the update, all in-game paid consumables will be unified under the new currency, Yog Points. The original currency held by Commanders can be exchanged for Yog Points at a certain ratio, and the purchasing power of the original currency will remain unchanged! All paid activities that consume Yog Points will be counted towards the cumulative recharge rewards.

【New Gameplay】

【Gold Consignment Hall】
Welcome to Arklance — a world full of opportunities and good fortune. Here, you can earn Gold by completing challenges in the Gold Valley. Afterward, you can list this Gold for sale at the Consignment Hall. Once the transaction is successful, the Gold in your possession will be converted into Gold Tickets. Finally, you can use these Gold Tickets to redeem various rare equipment and items at the Gold Ticket Hall. Wishing all Commanders abundant wealth and endless good luck in Arklance!

【Guild Ascension】
Consume "Gold" and "Guild Coin" to enhance the attributes of all Black Guards. A maximum of 45 upgrades can be made per week, with the upgrade count resetting every Sunday at 08:00 AM.

【Journey Story】
New stages, "The Phantom of Orient" and "My Heart Is Fire", have been added to Blacktide Difficulty 3. The "Handguard" dropped from these stages may have the "Tradeable" attribute, allowing it to be sold in the upcoming auction house system once implemented.

【Golden Valley】
Completing Chapter 14 of the main story unlocks the "Golden Valley " stage in the "Trial Labyrinth ". Challenge the greedy Goblins to earn tradeable Gold. Higher stage difficulty grants more Gold, and the "Endless Fortune " skill in the "Guild Ascension " system boosts Gold acquisition efficiency.


【Guild War S1: Origin Season】

Guild members across servers can now battle simultaneously!
The Guild War will start at 12:00 every Monday and Thursday, and will last for 48 hours each time. (Server time)

Serpent's Pursuit: Unleash Lightning Serpent towards a random target.

New Mode-【The Invitational Competition】

1. The Invitational Competition is a new competition organized by the Acadamy, the purpose is to attract commanders from various regions to fight together, to test the formation ability of commanders. Commanders can let their blackguards fight with players with similar power in the invitational competition, and win rewards for self and also the class.

2. After reaching the Academy Elite (400 points) in the Academy Cup, the commander will be eligible to participate in the Invitational by clicking on the Invitational entry. Qualified players can participate in the next round of the Invitational. The basic fighting rules of the Invitational are the same as those of the Academy Cup.

3. Each Invitational consists of eight stages: the 1st stage is the off-season, and the 2nd to 8th stages correspond to the 1st to 7th rounds of the competition, and the next invitational will be available after the completion of all stages. The planned period of the 1st invitational is 1-month, and the open period and rewards of subsequent invitationals may be dynamically adjusted according to the activeness of the commanders.

4. In each round of the battle, the Academy will divide the commanders into classes and combat areas based on the total battle power of the defensive team set by all commanders in the previous stage. The higher the battle power of the defensive team, the more advanced the area, the more score the commander can earn.

5. Each area contains 12 commanders, 6 Flame Ravens and 6 Frost Wolves. For a limited period of time in each round, each commander is required to fight a scoring best-of-three battle against the defensive lineup set for the previous period of the 6 opponents. In addition, the commander can practice 3 games without scoring and no battle report to test the battle power of self offensive team.

6. The combined wins of all 6 commanders of class in each area will determine the number of prizes that can be obtained by commanders, and the prizes won can only be claimed after the end of the stage. Rewards that are not claimed in time will be reclaimed by the Academy.

7. The score earned by the commander during the competition will also be converted into contribution points, and when the certain contribution points are reached, commanders can receive season-limited item rewards.

8. Avatar frame reward will be issued on second season

New PVE Mode-【Oblivion Land】

Introduction
The commander can reach "Oblivion Land" via the mermaid statue. Oblivion Land is known to be extremely dangerous but full of ancient treasures.
In Oblivion Land, the monsters you encounter and the route you travel might be different.

Rule
Clear All levels of "Mist Expanse" to unlock "Oblivion Land".

In "Oblivion Land", the commander is unable to fight in person due to the effects of unknown energy fluctuations, and needs to assign 3 teams of Blackguards for the challenge.
During the battle, all Blackguards cannot be revived.

In a single challenge, team has a protection time.
Each team can only fight for 90 seconds normally after protection time.
After 90 seconds, if the team is still fighting in a level, all blackguards in the team will keep losing HP until death, or killing all monsters.
If all Blackguards in the team dead, or team time reaches 0 in the previous level, switching to next team.
If no more team for switching, the challenge ends.

There are 1 free challenges per day, when the free challenges runs out, commander can use AP to challenge.
Commander can challenge multiple times simultaneously using Continuous Challenge.

Lots of new Equipment will be available on the drop list of this mode. And there will be a dedicated achievement system, commanders could obtain new summon currency: 【Sanguine Stone】 by completing Achievements

notes.title: [Book of Yog]Version Review and Future Outlook
notes.notes:
Introduction
Hello everyone, time is flying by and suddenly I realized that I haven't talked to you all for a long time.
It's an evening of an usual overtime day, and everyone is busy with the update on the end of April, but still I want to take some time out of my busy schedule to communicate with you all.

Since February, after a few months of integration, the new students have gradually integrated into the team, and we are finally able to ensure twice a month update frequency, while still having time for reflection and upgrades to the game.

In long term, we hope that the game will have an all-round improvement in content experience this year, which in one word that we want to make the Book of Yog more like a pure [game], we want to have a regular experience closer to RPG games, we want to build a ample storyline and design, we want to add a better combat operating experience to the core battles, and we want to greatly enhance the fun of collecting and idle treasures.

In fact, with the current achievement of "The Book of Yog", 99% of game teams (allow us to laugh at ourselves) will choose to seek stability and will choose more commercially conservative market strategies, which may temporarily bring us more revenue but cannot bring us closer to our dreams and ambitions, so we still want to try to break the original framework, although these efforts are not reflected in the current version, but we actually put a lot of effort into it, and it is like planting a seed, hopefully it could grow some new shoots about this year.

Next, we will briefly talk about the development plan of the conceptual modules (welfare and system optimization will continue, so I won't describe too much in this post):
Large treasure loot map, hero value balance, equipment amplification& equipment (runes, black stone) content extension, female Commander, the main storyline


1. Code Name: Treasure Hunting Relic
We are planing to launch a large PVE game in July, the design concept is that players can loot treasure and fight in a series of levels. (Inspired by Diablo 2)
The relics will drop the ultimate equipment of the game (runes, gems)
Players need to conquer the relics step by step, choose the most suitable route depending on your team power, fully explore the relics during limited time. Enhancing gear, character, collecting item will become more important before expedition.

[LUK] attribute will become important, it will determine whether certain precious equipment may drop, will also somehow affect your loot drop in the relics.

[Mythical Monsters] There are various mythical creatures in the ruins, find and defeat them, different creatures have different loot, commanders need to balance a good route with their strength.

[Story] There will be not only battles in the ruins, but also stories and eggs.

Scene production upgrade】We will improve the scene design process, presenting players with a higher quality design, not only in the art response, but a full range of design details



2. Blackguard Value Balance
We will continue to adjust all S Blackguards to improve the balance and playability of the game, after the adjustment of S Blackguards will not greatly weaker than the SS Blackguards
At the same time, we will increase and enrich more dimensions of combat mechanics, summoning flow, healing team, shield counter, poison, etc., gradually enrich the combat play style
At present, the completion of the program is about 60%, may be completed in June to July.



3. Equipment Amplification & Equipment (Runes, Gems) Content Extension
Some equipment (for example: Blackguard exclusive equipment) will be able to further amplified, currently our sketchy idea is that amplification will require the consumption of drawings, materials, and need to build a [perfect] equipment (equipment quality, affix level, enhancement level and other conditions to reach the perfect requirements, as equipment [perfect])
In order to let players experience more fun of equipment collection and combination, we will improve the speed of equipment (runes, black stones) content addition, and improve the quality of design. At the same time we are sure that they are available to any player.



4. Female Commander
The change for the female commander is roughly divided into two phases
Phase 1 model and character setting replacement (around July-August)
Phase 2 replacement of new combat mechanics (can be hand-operated or automatic) with new talent tree system (no timetable yet)



5. Main Story:
We will upgrade the entire Story playout system to provide better game story and performance, it is a large and complex project, so no clear timeline can be given at this time. Since this is something that needs to be accumulated and has a certain amount of stock before it can be launched, so please be patient with us.



6. Others 
We will continue to enrich the systems and gameplay within the guild, and due to time issues, we will dedicate an explanation to the guild module sometime in the future.



Last of all, thank you very much for your support of "Book of Yog", the game is currently in the [cocoon] period and is not sophisticated enough nor rich enough. But we believe that the most important thing for a team to succeed is the will and the heart; the will is the original impulse to do things well, the heart is the perseverance, so we believe it will finally come to the day to break the cocoon into a butterfly. We will definitely keep our promise and keep updating more and more interesting contents to make the game more and more fun.

【New Mode】-Everwinter Land
Introduction
Located at the northernmost tip of the continent, the Everwinter Land is so cold and covered with polar ice caps that it is always winter, hence the name.
The entrance portal to the Everwinter Land is located on the northwest corner of the Misty coast.

Unlcok Prerequisite
Clear Chapter 4 of the main story, Sorosat Castle, to unlock the Normal difficulty of Everwinter Land.
Clear Mist Expanse 100/650, to unlock the Hard/Blacktide difficulty.

Information
The new season starts on the first day of each month and lasts until the first day of the following month.

During the season, the stages and opening times of each difficulty are as follows:
On Normal/Hard difficulty, the opening times of 100 levels in each of the four stages are 1st/8th/15th/22nd of each month.
The Blacktide Difficulty only contains 100 levels in one stage, which is permanently open after unlocking.

If you successfully pass the level, the commander will receive first clear rewards such as diamonds, materials, blackguards and modifcation stones, depending on the difficulty.

At the end of the season, commanders who perform well on Hard and Blacktide difficulty can also receive ranking awards such as diamonds, Blacktide Medals, portraits, and head frames.
When the new season starts, all players' progress on each difficulty will be reset to 0, and all levels will need to be replayed.

Rule
In "The Everwinter Land", the commander is unable to fight in person due to the effects of unknown energy fluctuations, and needs to assign 3 teams of Blackguards for the challenge.
During the battle, all Blackguards killed in the level cannot be revived.

In a single challenge, each Blackguard can only fight for 90 seconds, and when the duration is up or the team dies, the next Blackguard will fight.
If all 3 Blackguards lose their fighting abilities, the challenge ends.

There are 3 free challenges per day, up to a maximum of 15.
When the free challenges runs out, commander can use AP to challenge.
*Preview only, for exact information please look forward to latest update announcement

New system - Rune system

The runes are divided into main rune and sub rune. The main runes have edges in different colors, players need to combine the color to activate rune skills. The runes will provide some attributes
The sub runes will drop randomly from the 151st levels of the Misty Mountains, and the main runes will drop from the bosses in the high levels of the Misty Mountains. We will introduce more main rune designs in the future.
Main rune and Sub rune can be equipped on unlocked rune slots, the hero will gain stat when equipped

Around the Edges required for the main rune skill combination, the adjacent slot must equip sub rune of the same color (linking effect)

As the provost of the college,  Nia has always kept the college in in perfect order with her excellent ability and high standards, and one can always find Nia's elegant appearance all over the college.

■Event Introduction
 Academy Cup is the tournament held regularly by the Blackguard Academy. Commanders can lead their teams to compete against other commanders' Black guards, get ranks according to their battle results and activeness, and win [Academy Coins]

■Event Rules
The Academy Cup will be unlocked after passing Ch. 8 "Arctic Anchorage", click Arena and select Academy Cup to enter

Commanders have 3 free challenges everyday. After all free challenges get used, the continued challenges will consume the [Academy Cup Ticket]. The number of free challenges and ticket purchase chances will be refreshed at 00:00 everyday

In a challenge, 3 matches are played, and each match can use 4 different Black Guards with a time limit of 90 seconds. The side who defeated all blackguards of the other side within the time limit wins the match. If timeout, the [Defending Side] wins. The commander who wins 2 of the 3 matches is the final winner

The challenger will get points if wins, lose points if loss for the most of time. The amount of points is affected by the rank and the score differences between the two commanders. The Commander with more points earns more [Academy Coins], commanders must manually click to claim [Academy Coins]. [Academy Coins] can be used to exchange for awards in [Black Market]

Triple Challenge is available with the cost of 2 extra [Academy Cup Tickets]. If won, get triple points. When lose, the points decresed won't be tripled. Abnormal exit during the battle will be recorded as a lose, and the [Academy Cup Tickets] used will be deducted

Novice - 0 to 149

notes.title: [Book of Yog] Version Review of Dec. and Future Outlook
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders, time runs so fast that I am not even aware it's been December. It was late night at weekend when I was writing this article, no one besides me, finally I can sit down by myself and write something quietly.

From November until now, we have had a lot of reliable and lovely new peers joined our team, and the technical team has doubled numbers now, which finally gives us hope in the struggling development progress.

First of all, I would like to apologize to all the players for the unpleasant experience caused by my personal negligence, but please trust me that we did not meant to do anything negative.

In the future, we will compensate players by providing more modification Stone benefits and resend  modification stone bundles (BF Box III, BF Box VI) to those who purchased them during Black Friday Sale, and increase modification stone benefits for little paid players. Please have an eye on our future announcement, and we promise that we will take extreme care about such adjustment before future update.

Then let's talk about the development plan in the following version:

Increase more player benefits, more equipment design, improve game balance, increase hero diversity, and expand main storyline

1. Offer more free events and lots of benefits regularly

2. Continue to increase the profit of monthly card, super monthly card and lifetime card

3. Improving hero balance and farmation diversity

In the current version, we found out that most players currently have a fairly monotonous selection of heroes

The next step we will gradually increase the power of some S-tier heroes and enlarge their characteristics

At the same time, we will increase the speed and quantity of releasing exclusive equipment to enrich the exploration of game content

4. Optimize  the time-cost of modifying equipment

Considering the current modification system operation is too tedious, we plan to introduce advanced modifiucation functions to improve the convenience of modification. The player will simply need to set the goals, and modication will run automatically, drastically reducing the amount of actions needed.

5. New story: Due to the expansion of manpower, we are planing to expand the main story. The player will experience the advance of the storyline in the future, and we are also working on the design of the main character's career system and career transition system

However, there is too many content needed to be accumulated, it will take some time to construct and finally launch for players to experience, please be patient with us

6. Improve the level design quality and add more and more interesting level elements


December - Plan before the Spring Festival

1. We will optimize the reset rule of Academy Gifts. For example, if all the rewards have been claimed after 10 days via reset, players can choose to manually reset and start a new round of Academy Gifts

2. Enhance some S-tier heroes' combat power. The first bunch of hero in the optimization plan list are: Crimson Scythe, Northland Princess, Mythic Instructor, Kingdom Huntress, Chief Raven 

3. Introduce some new functions: advanced modification command, one-click to use fragments, equipment plan saving

4. Add Heirloom modification feature: Heirlooms will also have affixes and can be modified

5. Introducing Equipment Rune system: It will be a brand new loot system and will randomly drop in certain levels. Runes are divided into primary runes and secondary runes. Each primary rune has a different effect when activated. Players need to place secondary runes properly into slots to activate more primary rune effects

6. Continue to optimize guild benefits and gameplay content to increase guild cohesion
	
7. Launch new Hero Challenge gameplay (Keep it secret for now)

8. Prepare the hero talent system and the new Mainland Stage system (these will be after the Lunar New Year, for now is just a blueprint)

===============

In the end, I want to say thanks to y'all for your continuously support at the Book of Yog. World Cup is ongoing, good luck to you and the team you supported.

I have been a Barca fan for over 20 years and have followed the club since Rivaldo; I Like Holland, more like Messi, early morning is the knockout series, hope Argentina good luck.

The Book of Yog will have an update maintenance on 20:00, Nov. 1st. (UTC+8) The maintenance is expected to take 60 - 180 minutes.

The maintenance will be a mandatory update. After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.

During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. Please logout before the maintenance to avoid any data loss.

【Fitch's Pumpkin Treasure Hunting】

Commanders can get [Fitch's Stitched Pumpkins] by consuming FP by exploring levels, and get [Fitch's Stitched Pumpkins] from the daily and weekly rewards. After opening the pumpkins, you can randomly get diamonds and Halloween items.

For specific details:

Ultimate Skill: [Blade Flurry] Ophelia stabs 5 times consecutively within 5 meters in front over 1 sec, each stab causes lightning damage equal to physical power, releases a fatal stab after 0.5 sec, causing damage equal to physical power, then knocks back the enemy and makes them electrocuted.
Combat Skill: [Glowstep] Charge 6 meters to the target direction, deal lightning damage equal to physical power to the enemies on the path, stun the enemy that in Electrocution state for 1 sec.
Support Skill: 
[Thunderous Justice] Last attack of Blade Flurry will reset the CD of Glowstep, and the next Glowstep's crit chance increased by {0}.

[Flash Assault] When Glowstep causes crit damage, the CD of Glowstep reduced by {0} sec, and damage dealt of Glowstep to enemy in Electrocution state increased by 50%.
[Peerless Blademaster] When Onslaught Will triggered, Ophelia gain 1 stack of Blademaster, each stack of Blademaster increases Ophelia's skill crit chance and crit damage by {0}. And every 7 points of physical mastery will increase skill crit chance and crit damage from each stack of Blademaster by 0.5%, stacking up to 5 times and last for 20 sec.

【14 Days Limited Time Sign-in Event】

■Event Details
During the qualification activation of the event, players who complete the chapter 1: area 3-2 [normal] can activate the 14-day limited-time sign-in qualification.
After activating the qualification, players can log to the game after 8:00 every day to sign-in at the event interface to get gifts.
[Qualification Activation Duration: From November 01 to November 14, 2022]
[Event Duration: From November 01 to December 6, 2022]

■Event Notes
During the qualification activation period, if players who meet the activation conditions do not activate the event, they will not be able to participate in the event after the qualification activation expires.
For players who have activated the sign-in qualification, if the sign-in is not completed after the event ends, the event interface will close.

■Sign-in Gifts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/09aed3d508086ec73d6a257cb83cc9383cd86553.png

【New Event of Ra's Tower - Lula Campaign】
1. Ra's Tower will have 10 tower master positions for players to compete for (ranked from low to high).
2. The tower owner will get extra Lula every Monday (same arena time). If the tower owner is appointed as the [Sword Bearer] of the guild, he and his guild members can also get Guild Coins rewards every week.
3. Complete the specified number of floors in Ra's Tower can obtain the challenge qualification of the corresponding sequence of tower master. The higher the tower master sequence, the higher the completion number of floors required.
4. Players will occupy the sequence position immediately if he challenges the tower master success.

【Major adjustment】
【Explore Chapter Structure adjustment and New Chapter Content】
1. The structure of some exploration chapters has been adjusted, and most of the chapters have been merged. The original 26 chapters of exploration chapters will be adjusted to 9 chapters, and the total number of levels will remain unchanged.
2. New exploration chapter: Chapter 9, and chapter 9 will drop new gears: badges & pants.

【Ancients of Echo Level Rules Adjustment】
1. For players whose Ancients level is > 400, their Ancients of Echo will be reset to level 400. All materials will be 100% returned by mail.
2. The upgrade of Ancients of Echo will no longer consume Lula.
3. The level of Ancients of Echo can increase the upper limit (each mythical/eternal hero increases the upper limit of the level by 10/25).

New talent system of the Ancients of Echo [Extremis]
Ancients of Echo will get extremis points each time when level up, which can be allocated in the [Extremis] interface to enhance abilities.

Optimization of the Ancients of Echo upgrade operation.

【Other Level Adjustments】
1. The Misty Mountaions level has added 50 levels.
2. The number of floors in Ra's Tower has been increased to 6001 to 7000.
3. Four new exclusive equipment drops have been added to the Misty Level.
4. Two new heirlooms have been added to the Mist Shop.

【Front Line Adjustment】
Now, when the Blackguard upgrades the front line, his own quality needs to be at least epic +.

【Blackstone Adjustment】
Replaced all blackstones' icon styles

【Model Optimization】
Iterated the model of the SS-rank hero - Frozen Heart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/cca43609b24c591b40c643c89814b427e863e8d4.png

[Bug fixes and other optimizations]
1. Fixed an issue that when equipping Lightning Master would cause damage to teammates.
2. [In order to avoid the presence of too many magic bullets at the same time and cause the lagging], the effect of the Magic Bullets set is adjusted as follows:
The skill damage of the Magic Bullets set is increased by 300%, and the fire interval of magic bullets is increased by 100%.
The magic bullet fired has been changed from group damage to single-target damage.
3. Fixed the problem that the effect of the gear [Finger of Yang Yan] could not take effect correctly.
4. Fix the problem that the gear [Redemption Angel] may cause the game to crash.
5. Verdant Ranger's passive skill [Ranger Training] has been changed to: increases 15% of dodge chance and 15% skill crit chance.
6. Asura's Blade's skill【Blessing of Kimono】has been changed to: When there are no enemies within 6 meters, Sakura will step through the shadow to flash behind the nearest enemy. The trigger chance of Shadowmeld increased by 10% and the duration increased.
7. Fixed the problem that the commander task could not be completed when the hero level met the commander task conditions.
8. Fixed an issue that the healing effect did not take effect on characters who were invincible.
9. Legendary Washing Stone and Immortal Washing Stone will still retain the existing attributes after use.
10. Now players can preview the loot drops from unlocked levels of the Misty Levels.
11. Now enter the equipment enhancement interface, the equipment that has not been enhanced to the full level will be selected by default.
12. Optimized the settlement display rules of the battle settlement.
13. Fixed the issue that when reset a hero, the heroes be obtained after reset would be regarded as a newly acquired hero and included in the Index.
14. Fixed the incorrect text description of equipment: [Wild Hunt] & [Crimson Lament].
15. Fixed the problem that the hero level-related tasks could not be completed after the Ancients of Echo breakthrough.
16. The arena tickets were renamed, and the purchase price was adjusted.
17. Fixed the problem that only one of the relics will be effective when multiple relics are equipped in the team.
18. Fixed an issue that the hero might not attack after teleporting.
19. Optimized the problem that all characters do not move during the idle.
20. Auto-battle function of The Misty Mountains is enabled

notes.title: Oct. 19th Update Contents Preview
notes.notes:
Hi dear commanders, the following are the introduction of the contents of the Oct. 19th update.

Summoning Optimization
New SS Blackguard Wishlist: When you pull an SS Blackguard, there is an 80% rate to obtain the SS Blackguard that you selected in the wishlist.
The wishlist resets at 8:00 a.m every day. After the selected SS Blackguard is obtained, you need to wait until the reset at 8:00 the next day before continuing to select.

Mall Contents Update
New Scarlett outfit: [Romance on White Beach]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/dbfeb303f2afa0548c673ab2f38a290dd676ec95.png

New packages: New contents of daily and weekly gift packs, new limited-time gift packs.

Guild Optimization
1. Now the guild will be disbanded immediately after the disbanding time is up.
2. The guild name change function is available now. The guild leader and vice-leader can change the guild name by consuming 1500 diamonds.
3. The guild interface has been iterated.

Ranking Board Optimization
1. Optimized the ranking board interface.
2. New ranking board: Hard Level and Misty Mountains. The ranking board will display guild name now. 
3. Optimized the ranking logic. Now, under the same level and stage, the player who complete the battle with the shorter the time, the higher the ranking he will get.

Modification Optimization
1. New reset function of gear enhancement. Now reset the enhanced gears, will return 100% of the consumed materials.
2. Optimized the auto enhancement function.
3. After selecting the mythical gear in the Blackguard interface, you can jump to the modification interface.

Combat Optimization and Skill Adjustment
1. The effect of Asura's Katana skill [Heart of Killing] has been adjusted from (crit chance increased by 15%/crit damage increased by 50%) to (crit chance increased by 30%/crit damage increased by 75%)
2. General skills for assassian Blackguards: [Barrier] replaced with [Shadow Escape]
[Shadow Escape]: When taking damage, there is a 10% chance to trigger Shadow Escape, immune to the damage, and immune to all damage for the next 0.2 sec, trigger interval 10 sec.
3. Now the skill to dispel buffs can dispel all buffs directly, instead of only dispelling 1 buff.

Levels and Stages Adjustment
1. Hard and Blacktide difficulty will drop Soul Crystal now.
2. The monsters on Misty Mountains will drop Soul Crystal now.
3. New ring and belt will drop in the Misty Mountains.
4. The number of floors of the Tower of Suncaller has been increased from 5001 to 6000.

Performance Optimization
New Setting option: new Graphics Quality setting:
"Low": cancel the light projection effect, save performance.
"Medium": the current effect.
"High": improve the clarity of 3D model display in interface such as the Blackguard interface.

Chat Interface Optimization
Iterate the chat interface, new instant message push function is available (more optimization content will be implemented in subsequent versions)

Bug Fixes and Other Optimizations
Fixed an issue that the passive skill [Frozen Fury] of the Northland Princess did not work correctly.
Fixed an issue that the invincibility state of the ultimate skill of Asura's Blade did not take effect.
White Dragonborn: Fixed an issue that the skill: [Interception] would also trigger a charge when the enemy dies.
Fixed an issue that non-Mystic heroes would also trigger the Mystic Front rage restore effect.
Fixed an issue that Asura's Blade would abnormally restore rage when releasing the ultimate skill.
Fixed an issue that the buff icon did not disappear when Bright Seraphim was dispelled during the boss battle of the Misty Mountains.
Fixed the bug that the equipment [Wild Hunt]'s skill: boost the damage dealt to the target take effect abnormally.
Optimize the experience of the difficulty switching function of the map in the exploration level: After switching the difficulty, the player will no longer stay in the current level, but automatically jump to the frontmost level of the selected difficulty.
Fixed an issue that Blackstone: Frosthoof and Blackstone: Ice Phoenix caused the commander to stand behind the team.
In some scenes in the main city where you can control the movement of the commander with the mouse, add a new return button in the upper right corner of the interface.
The mission display in the lower left corner of the battle interface has been reduced, add a new scrolling status that can view the full text of the mission.
Now in the awakening interface, when you don't need to consume the same cards to awakening, but you select the same cards (for example select SS cards when you need not consume it), there will be a consumption reminder.
Optimized the AI ​​logic when a Blackguard cast a spell channel type skill.
Optimized the equipment slot, now it will not be annoying anymore when you select equipments.
Fixed the preview error of level 5 Blackstone chests.
Optimized the blocking word database, and deleted some blocking words that are too strict.
Optimized the problem that sometimes the UI was incorrectly displayed when the battle was settled.
New skin preview function in skin shop.
Optimize the early novice guide experience.
Optimized the icon prompt when new skills can be upgraded.
Added two battle scenes.

notes.title: [Book of Yog] Version Review of Sept. and Future Outlook
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders, I'm Lao Wang, long time no see. Time has passed quickly, the high temperature in summer is finally over, and September is coming to an end before I had realized. Well, just intend to continue to share with you about this month's development feeling and future plans.

    Honestly, September was a bit of a contradiction for us. For us who have been in a state of high-intensity overtime, there are two holidays in the middle of September and the end of the month, which gives our team more time to relax. But it also means that there are fewer workdays available for development, and many of the ideas and plans on the to-do list are delayed, which makes us a little anxious.

    I would also like to thank everyone for giving us enough support, as well as the pertinent criticism and encouragement from all commanders, which has given us greater confidence in our own path. For game content, we know that bringing the fun of the game to everyone is our final and only goal, and we will continue to expand tasks, events, loot, new characters, and levels to make the game be more fulfilling and interesting.

    Right now, our team is working hard to fix a few remaining issues while thinking about how to add new content. As a young team lack of technical accumulation, we are also constantly developing new tools to improve the efficiency of development. The whole pace of the development of our game is in an accelerated process, it will become faster and more stable, so please stay tuned and give us more time.

Well, let's talk about the development plan in the following version:

Increase player benefits, enrich the social interaction of the game, and develop new level and modes

1. New Chat System
    We will refactor the chat system of the game to enhance the social experience of players with social needs, so that players can feel the activity of other players in the server.

2. Enrich the Gameplay of the Guild System
    The Guild System is one of the contents that we take very seriously recently.
    I plan to enrich the benefits of the guild system, so that players can obtain a lot of resources in the guild, and at the same time it can help player improve the collection speed of characters greatly.
    We hope that players can become an active group and have their own role in the team, which can bring more benefits to themselves and their companions.

3. Enrich Battle Mode and Team Formation
    We noticed that the current formation of heroes is a bit too monotonous, resulting in a simple and boring battle rhythm. We hope that players can have more available ideas and have more battle strategy options. 
    We have found the reason that caused this situation and are working to optimize it. We are confident that we can optimize it, but it will take about 1-3 months to improve it with gradual updates.

4. Optimize and Reduce the Cost of the Gear Modification
    At present, it needs to be cost dearly to obtain some advanced modification stones in the game, which increases part of the burden during the play. We believe that the modification system should be a basic fun in the game. If the player can only cost dearly to experience this system, it will affect the enthusiasm of players to try the new gears, which is not conducive to the healthy development of the game ecology.
    Regarding modification stones, we will gradually optimize the relevant output and corresponding prices. With the increase in the number of items dropped, players can obtain modification items more conveniently and efficiently.

5. New Ranking, and New Gameplay Mode of the Level
Such as:
    Challenge the exploration level with single commander: can only use commander to challenge the new exploration levels.
    Blackguard Class Tower: challenge the new level of the Tower of Suncaller, commander can only use a specific class of Blackguard to challenge the new levels of the tower.

6. Development Plan from September to October

1. Academy Gifts will greatly enhance the benefits and shorten the reset time.

2. We are considering adding a new level of hero awakening. Awakening will activate a new hero skill, but we do not have time and energy to design the new skills of all heroes at the same time, so the new hero awakening will be enabled in batches.

3. Strengthen the abilities of some S-rank heroes, improve and strengthen assassin and guardian heroes, including modifying the effect of the Front System, adding exclusive gear, etc.

4. Continue to optimize the battle system to enrich the battle rhythm and hero training mode.

5. Optimize the information available for the modification system, reduce the difficulty of getting started with the modification system, and add new functions. For example, players can preview the affix that may be randomly obtained during modification, etc.

6. Continue to extend the number of the levels of the Misty Mountains and the Tower of Suncaller, add more designs of the heirloom, improve heirloom attributes, and reduce the difficulty of the Misty Mountains in the early stage, so that more players can experience this gameplay.

7. Continue to work on the optimization of game performance.

    Thank you for reading to the end, here is a small gift to thank you for your support!

    [LAOWANG001] DiamondsX1000, Invalid Time: 30th Sept.

notes.title: [Book of Yog] August Version Review
notes.notes:
Hi guys, I'm Lao Wang.

    The version in mid-August is finally online, and I can finally spare some time to chat with you about these days and the future.

    In terms of development process, this version update is torturous. We set aside more time than usual, but there were still many, many serious problems that caused the team to work overtime until the early hours of the morning, and everyone was exhausted physically and mentally.

    We have done a review: the team has shortcomings in testing capabilities, so we have not been able to find and solve many problems in time. In the future, we need to improve our capabilities to solve these problems.

    We have a lot of development content on our to do list, and frankly we are very confident about the future game content. However, due to the experience and the size of the team, the actual development time left for each version is less than 10 working days. I can only make limited arrangements to take care of the players and the partners in the team.

    There is a girl in our technical team. She commutes to and from work for more than 3 hours every day. I don’t want the whole team to work until late at night, which will also break us from the inside.

    I hope that players can understand us a little while waiting anxiously for the game content. Our team is young, we make mistakes and sometimes we don't think well, but we try to be the best we can.

    We are also looking for more capable partners to solve the technical problems of the team and make the player's game experience smoother. At the same time, our goal has always been to make games easier and more fun.

    Next, let's talk about the future plan:

Increase the benefits of the game
1. We will increase the stability of obtaining heroes from the summoning. After reaching a certain number of pulls, you will be able to obtain the "Blackguard Roster".
2. We will increase the drop of hero fragments in the loots. As the level progresses, players can get more and more hero fragments from the loots, including SS heroes.
3. New activity gameplay that everyone can participate and can obtain more rewards.
4. We are considering to further enhance the rewards of the monthly card.

Content development direction
1. Great Rift gameplay
For the version at the end of August, we plan to launch the "Great Rift" gameplay. Players can experience new gameplay, challenge new levels and collect legendary runes. However, due to the tight development cycle, we expect it to be only an initial version when it is released. Hope players can understand us. In the future, we will improve the gameplay and add more and more legendary runes.

2. Increase the content of the main storyline in the level
This is a very important part of our original plan, and we will gradually add the storyline in the game. For the plot content, whether it is development, or how to design and present it in the game, it is not a easy work, so we will gradually add some ​​contents.
Players can gradually understand more stories of Commander, Blackguard and Arkrance during the game, gain talent skill points (another new system), and challenge the enemy.

3. Commander talent system
The talent skill tree is a system we have planned for a long time, and we have always been eager to try such a fun system.
In our plan, when the commander upgrades the soul level, talent points can be obtained, and the reasonable allocation of talent points will make your commander more powerful and more distinctive.
The commander's class transfer and class talent system will also be opened in the future.

There are still many things I want to talk to you about, but there are still many things to be busy with, let's see you next time!

Thank you all for your love and support of Book of Yog!

notes.title: About the English language version plan
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders,

Due to lack of manpower and lack of experience, in the previous English version, we only carried out machine translation of important parts. Therefore, for a long time, the English version has problems such as missing text translation, machine translation errors, inconsistent terms, etc., which have caused a terrible game experience. We are deeply sorry for this.

At present, the staff who in charge of translation, is not only in charge of the optimization of the English version but also in charge of other work contents. Therefore, it's hard to perfect this part of the translation work quickly. For the current existing translation problems, we can only deal with different parts gradually. Step by step, such like hero details to skills to items, etc.. Therefore, the perfect optimization of the English version will be a long-term project, but our work has already started, and we guarantee that the translation-optimized contents will be perfected asap.

Before the last data deletion test on July 16 launched, in order to ensure that players in English-speaking regions can experience the game smoothly, we have temporarily machine-translated all texts in the game (some new contents may be missed). The text of some important systems has been refined to ensure that the main game experience will not be greatly affected.

In the future, we will refine the text of the game according to the following plans:

1. Gradually proofread and fine-tune all text content to reduce errors.
2. Unify proper nouns (heroes, skills, equipment, etc.) to facilitate players to communicate.
3. Process the text content as soon as the content is updated.

Because of our limited manpower, this work will be a relatively long-term project for us, but we promise that we will start the text translation as soon as possible, and hope that commanders will remain patient and confident in us! Thanks for your understanding and support!
